events.event_name: Christian Louboutin Beauty — Fétiche Wardrobe of Scents
events.what_it_is: An immersive NYFW fragrance pop-up centered on Christian Louboutin Beauty's Fétiche fragrance collection.
events.what_is_free: Free public access to the fragrance experience; current event coverage also advertises gifts and giveaways while supplies last.
events.caveats: The venue's current history independently confirms Christian Louboutin Fétiche at 21 Spring St from September 12–14. Giveaway quantities are not guaranteed.
events.practical_notes: September 12–14 at 21 Spring St; exact daily hours were not established strongly enough in the audit, so check the source before going.

events.address: Washington Square Park Arch, Washington Square N, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: An open-air NYFW runway and shopping experience with a live performance by Benzo B.
events.what_is_free: The event is explicitly listed as free and open to the public.
events.caveats: Current event listing confirms September 13 from 1–4 PM at the Washington Square Park Arch and $0 admission.
events.practical_notes: Open-air event; no RSVP requirement was established in the verified listing.

events.what_it_is: A public NYFW stop-in pop-up with hair and beauty touch-ups, a photo booth, coffee and customizable knee-highs.
events.what_is_free: Free admission, coffee, hairstyle touch-ups, photo booth and branded stickers. Embroidery is free with purchase of eligible knee-highs.
events.caveats: Open to the public. Free hand embroidery requires purchase of the 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs; other complimentary activations may be capacity or supply limited.
events.practical_notes: Both Saturday and Sunday run 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette St.

events.what_it_is: Renée NYC's NYFW debut, an immersive 20-look presentation titled Blue 47.
events.what_is_free: No free-admission or giveaway claim is made without stronger ticket evidence.
events.caveats: The live Posh listing confirms Renée NYC, Saturday September 12, 2026 and Space LES. The supplied event post gives a 1:30 PM start. End time and public ticket terms were not independently exposed, so they are not invented.
events.practical_notes: Starts at 1:30 PM. Check the Posh listing for current access details before going.

events.what_it_is: A Bodega By V NYFW runway spotlighting emerging sustainable NYC designers, followed by a pop-up market and after-party programming.
events.what_is_free: The supplied event post advertises an after-party with an open bar, vendors, DJs and a surprise performance; admission price was not independently established.
events.caveats: The live 2026 Posh listing confirms Friday September 11 and 197 Plymouth St. The supplied post gives a 6:30 PM runway start. This is treated as the same underlying Corner Store Couture program rather than creating a duplicate for its after-party component.
events.practical_notes: Runway begins at 6:30 PM; check Posh for current ticket/access status.

events.event_name: Fashion vs. Fantasy NYFW Runway Show
events.what_it_is: Brooklyn Bound Vintage's handmade NYFW runway event with seven designers, shopping, live music, flash tattoos, a photo booth and zines.
events.what_is_free: The event advertises free drinks among its activations, but admission itself is ticketed.
events.caveats: Dreamworldgirl's current event page confirms September 13, 4–8 PM, a 6:30 PM show and $20 tickets. The supplied post separately says VIP activations begin at 4 PM and doors at 5 PM; Eventeny has shown a broader 6–9 PM event window, so the more granular schedule is preserved rather than silently flattening the discrepancy.
events.practical_notes: VIP activations 4 PM; doors 5 PM; runway 6:30 PM. Ticketed event.

events.address: USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center, Fountain Plaza, Flushing, NY 11368
events.what_it_is: Tiffany & Co.'s official US Open pop-up displaying championship trophies and the craft behind their creation, with photo experiences.
events.what_is_free: The pop-up itself is an on-site US Open activation; access should not be represented as a free standalone public event because it is inside the tournament grounds.
events.caveats: Official US Open and Tiffany sources confirm the pop-up runs August 23–September 13 at the National Tennis Center. It is located inside the US Open site, so tournament-ground access rules apply.
events.practical_notes: Final day is September 13. Located in Fountain Plaza inside the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center.
